about.title: About
about.lead: Privacy is a prerequisite for freedom. The ability to transact without being watched, profiled, or gatekept by data-hungry intermediaries isn't a luxury: it's the foundation of any free market, and ultimately of any free society.
about.p1: P2P sats is a tool for the peer-to-peer Bitcoin market. It pulls live order data from public Nostr relays, where platforms like Mostro, lnp2pbot, RoboSats, and Peach broadcast their offers under NIP-69, and brings everything into a single, unified view.
about.p2: Today this market is fragmented. Liquidity, prices, and payment options are spread thinly across separate apps and bots, each with its own siloed slice of the order flow. That fragmentation costs everyone (worse fills, slower matches, and arbitrage left on the table). By unifying the view, P2P sats helps traders find each other and compare prices across venues, with the goal of deeper liquidity and a more efficient market overall.
about.p3: This site doesn't hold accounts, take orders, or touch funds. It's purely a read-only window into what's already public on the relays. To actually trade, head to the platform that posted the order you're interested in.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This page explains what data p2psats.app collects, why, and what rights you have over it. Short version: we collect only what's needed to run the alert service, share nothing for advertising, and you can request deletion at any time.

collect.email: Email address — provided when you sign in or link an email notification channel.
collect.nostr: Nostr public key (npub/hex) — provided when you sign in with Nostr or link a Nostr DM channel.
collect.accountId: Internal account ID — generated at sign-up, used to tie your data together.
collect.alerts: Alert configurations — the filters and channels you set up.
collect.dispatchLogs: Alert dispatch logs — records of notifications sent (timestamp, channel, alert ID, order ID). Used to prevent duplicate deliveries and diagnose delivery failures.

why.auth: Authentication — to let you sign in and access your alerts.
why.dispatch: Alert delivery — to send notifications to the email address or Nostr identity you configured.

privacy.cookies: We set one cookie: __session, an HTTP-only authentication cookie used to keep you signed in. To understand how the app is used and improve it, we run our own self-hosted Umami instance, which collects only aggregate, anonymous usage data and sets no tracking cookies. This data stays on our infrastructure — it is never shared with third parties, and we use no third-party analytics or advertising trackers.

subprocessors.resend: Resend (resend.com) — handles transactional email: sign-in magic links and email alert notifications.
subprocessors.yadio: Yadio (yadio.io) — provides live fiat exchange rates. These are fetched directly by your browser from yadio.io (about every 5 minutes), so your IP address is visible to yadio when rates load. No account data is sent — only the rate request itself.
subprocessors.hosting: The backend and database (MySQL) are self-hosted. No data is sent to third-party analytics or advertising services.

retention.alerts: Alert configurations are kept until you disable or delete them.
retention.logs: Dispatch logs are retained for approximately 90 days for service reliability, then purged.

rights.intro: You have the right to access and delete the personal data we hold about you.
rights.access: Access — you can ask us what data we hold and receive a copy.
rights.deletion: Deletion — you can ask us to delete your account and all associated data.
rights.deletionNote: Self-serve account deletion is not yet available in the UI. Until it is, email us to request deletion and we will process it manually.
rights.response: We will respond to any data request within 30 days (GDPR Article 12).
